native_context: POSIX privileged file creation and path authority
taxonomy_note: Planning lens only; actual root-cause mapping is independent.

controls.boundary: POSIX privileged file creation and path authority — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Record effective/real UID/GID, supplementary groups, umask, directory ownership and descriptor open/check/use. Identify who controls every parent component, not only the basename.
controls.controlled_verification: In an owned temporary tree use inert marker files to inspect whether the privileged-equivalent operation consumes the same inode it checked. Use supported atomic/descriptor-relative operations and a controlled link/parent replacement when relevant; never target system files.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: O_NOFOLLOW on a final component is not general protection for every parent. A writable directory alone needs a reachable privileged consumer and replacement/creation authority to establish the defect.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind file authority to appropriate descriptors/atomic operations and trusted parents under platform semantics. Retest normal creation, original replacement/link case and cleanup/object identity.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
